name: The Mission House
description:
Hidden behind an eye-catching Victorian façade lies 1146 Florida, a three-bedroom, three-and-a-half bath home encompassing nearly 3,000 square feet of living space in the vibrant Mission District. Designed by Tom McElroy Architecture, this uber-upgraded property provides the penultimate in sophisticated living, all within one of San Francisco’s most celebrated neighborhoods.

Spanning three spacious levels, this home underwent an extensive renovation, resulting in a modern gem replete with exquisite finishes. The entertainment possibilities are endless, thanks to an open-concept floor plan and lushly landscaped garden with built-in barbecue, fountain, pergola, and fire pit – indoor-outdoor living meant to make the most of the best climate in the city. 

Just a block away from the booming 24th Street corridor, this home is step
s away from some of the city’s highlights: eateries, coffee shops, and all the unique offerings that define San Francisco. There’s a reason everyone gathers in the Mission – and many compelling factors that will draw you to call 1146 Florida home. 

*Square footage is approximate, per public records
